# Voxa AI

> Voxa AI designs, builds and runs AI voice agents for businesses. The agents answer every call on the first ring, 24/7, handle many callers at once, book appointments, take phone orders, qualify leads and follow up with customers, and log every caller's details to Google Sheets, Excel or a CRM. Most agents go live in about 10 days.

Voxa AI works with clinics, restaurants, home services, real estate, salons and gyms, law firms, auto dealers, hotels and online stores. Pricing is a one-time setup plus a flat monthly fee, quoted after a 20-minute call.

## Services

- [AI receptionist](https://voxa.in/#agents): answers every call, handles common questions, routes urgent calls and takes messages
- [Appointment booking](https://voxa.in/#agents): books, reschedules and cancels in the business calendar and texts a confirmation
- [Phone ordering](https://voxa.in/#agents): takes orders with modifiers and add-ons and sends them to the kitchen or POS
- [Lead qualification](https://voxa.in/#agents): calls new leads within a minute, qualifies them and books sales calls
- [Customer support](https://voxa.in/#agents): order status, returns, billing and first-line troubleshooting
- [Reminders and confirmations](https://voxa.in/#agents): outbound calls that confirm appointments and recover no-shows
- [Win-back campaigns](https://voxa.in/#agents): calls past customers and collects reviews
- [Intake and dispatch](https://voxa.in/#agents): collects caller details and pages on-call staff for emergencies
